spec.title: Setup: rerun the brief's stock JBMC 6.11.0 preflight with the preflight and the installed binary and models
spec.description: Setup for llm-dlc/loops/jbmc-java-semantics-gap-brief.md, no claims and no project verifier. Reruns the brief's two runnable seeds (Semantics: 8 entries; ExtraOpeners: 6 entries; the brief's flags) and the named upstream JBMC regressions (StartsWith, toCodePoint, synchronized-methods, virtual5, default-methods, no-main-object-array-elements-maybe-null1/2; their test.desc files, fixtures compiled by the setup) with stock JBMC 6.11.0 in three pairings: (1) the Ubuntu 22.04 release binary and its core-models.jar, whose digests equal the brief's preflight (2cf57254…, 2a05026b…); (2) the installed Ubuntu 24.04 binary and models (200f4cbb…, a31ef93b…); (3) the installed binary with the 22.04 models. A capped probe already showed ExtraOpeners.firstDeclared FAILURE with the 22.04 models and SUCCESS with the installed ones, so the job records which pairing reproduces each preflight result. Compiled seeds: ~/.cache/in-the-loop/jbmc-java-semantics-gap/probes/seed/cls. Script: scripts/jbmc_repro.py in that folder (sha256 in the setup record). Per-run timeout 1200 s.
spec.expected: Pairing 1 gives the brief's results: SUCCESS for fraction, narrow, prefix, categories, dispatch, endian, hex; FAILURE for floorOnly, wraps, noNullCell, noItemCell, firstDeclared, halfSwap, lowFirst; CORE regressions pass. Differences in pairings 2 and 3 are recorded, not failures.
